name: Gnatastrophe
name_status: Renamed Gnatastrophe by Sean on 2026-10-23; stable ID retained
description: A cloud of sewer flies that wanders until a plumber approaches, then reforms into a flying weapon shape and gives chase.
implementation_status: Packaged in Prototype144; bounded still review passed; full-cycle/all-angle animation review pending.

backstory.text: A maintenance crew first reported Gnatastrophe as a swarm circling a blocked vent with the persistence of aircraft waiting for landing clearance. They have since been spotted throughout the sewers, flying in close formation toward no particular destination. Their buzzing carries impressively far for something with so little to report. Plumbers and monsters alike suffer for wandering into their flight path. Nobody has identified a commanding officer, although several flies appear to be taking credit.
backstory.canon_note: Current name selected by Sean October 23; aviation-flavored history remains a Storyboarding draft, not new mechanics.

health.role: wandering swarm that acquires nearby heroes and pursues; visual weapon forms share damage
health.encounter_stage: Early first-level traversal, initially shown alone before mixed fights
health.rationale: Sean requested at least two hits from his current starter weapon. At24HP both active first-level starters take two hits: Sean18 damage leaves6HP; Tony12 leaves12HP. Preserve a light wandering obstacle without adding a third Tony hit.
health.comparison: hits_to_defeat uses canonical base weapon damage for schema validation. The playable first level applies approved starter overrides; see active_first_level_comparison. No armor or per-fly damage multiplication.

health.status: 24HP integrated for Prototype81; live balance review pending

marketing.status: Not requested for current sprite mockup; pending future production

lore_quirk.text: An absurdly self-important air force with no flight plan or identifiable commanding officer.
lore_quirk.mechanics_constraint: Historical no-pursuit restriction superseded by approved November2 hunting mode. No guns, projectiles or weapon-specific damage mechanics.

movement.algorithm: Retain heading. At timed updates add bounded random angular offset, then steer smoothly with speed/turn/acceleration limits. Slow to hover and accelerate out; do not instantaneously reset velocity.
movement.inputs: Per-swarm seeded RNG, physics time, authored bounds and solid geometry only; no player/enemy position in steering.
movement.priority: Collision safety first, boundary/obstacle steering second, random wander third. Do not sum equal opposing forces and jitter in corners.
movement.bounds: Author simple connected flight regions, accounting for full collider radius. Steer before edge; swept collision is final protection. Keep spawn/region away from narrow mandatory paths.
movement.obstacles: Use current physical solids and partially opened doors. Avoid wall penetration; slide away or turn into valid clearance. One-way platforms can be crossed only when tagged explicitly for swarm flight.
movement.stuck_recovery: If intended movement makes less than4px progress over1s outside intentional hover, select a collision-free inward heading using bounded candidate checks; never teleport. If no route is free, hover harmlessly until geometry changes and retry at bounded intervals.
movement.overlap: No avoidance of heroes/monsters: contact is incidental. Other swarms may overlap, sharing target cooldown.
movement.safe_route: First introduction leaves a clear bypass and room to learn. Initial swarms optional and excluded from gate-clear requirements; their kills of existing gate enemies still count.
movement.animation: Select from actual velocity after collision. Use4px/s hover threshold and20% dominant-axis hysteresis; preserve loop clock across direction changes to avoid frame-zero flicker.
movement.determinism: Fixed physics updates; seeded RNG only at elapsed decision events, never per render frame. Separate seeds per spawn ID; cap catch-up after long stalls.
movement.tuning_status: Initial implementation defaults; validate visually and adjust before claiming feel is final.
movement.scope: Legacy environmental base tuning only. Active shared Gnatastrophe uses hunting_mode continuous70px/s wandering and140px/s charges, without hover pauses.

contact.hero_damage_scale: Current contact-hit player HP scale; revisit with any HP migration.
contact.monster_damage_scale: Current enemy numeric HP scale; asymmetry intentional, not six hero damage.
contact.cooldown_scope: One sewer-fly damage cooldown on each target shared across all swarms, preventing stacked swarm hits. Leaving/re-entering overlap does not reset it.
contact.first_hit: Immediate valid overlap if target cooldown and invulnerability permit; then next at1.5s minimum.
contact.tick_rule: Use time, not frame count. No accumulated burst or catch-up ticks after pause/large delta.
contact.player_protection: Honor existing global hurt invulnerability and respawn/death/dialogue protections. Successful contact starts normal invulnerability; no stacked hazard hits.
contact.damage_dispatch: Use normal target damage/death pipeline; one swarm collision, not one hit per tiny bug.

damage: living ordinary monsters including Flushfiends and Hallowed Widows
target_filter.bosses: Contact may damage a boss only through its exposed damageable collider and normal vulnerability rules; never bypass shell or closed phase. One damage event per boss even across overlapping parts.
target_filter.credit: Monsters killed by swarm count as defeated for encounter gates, but not player weapon kills or player-kill achievements.
target_filter.notes: Same-swarm immunity and boss rules are proposed filters, not explicit user decisions.

spawn_lifecycle.placement: Authored bounded spawn regions with valid walk-around space; no endless random generation.
spawn_lifecycle.first_pass_limit: One swarm per intro region; maximum two per encounter for initial evaluation.
spawn_lifecycle.spawn: Pre-place off camera or activate entirely beyond viewport; no visible pop-in or spawning overlapping another actor.
spawn_lifecycle.despawn: Camera culling does not kill/reset actor. Suspend only when region truly unloaded; preserve HP, death and encounter state.
spawn_lifecycle.restart: Full restart restores placement, health and deterministic seed; checkpoint respawn preserves defeated swarms like other enemies.
spawn_lifecycle.death: Disable contact immediately at0HP, play finite disperse/fall animation and remove after completion. No lingering damaging particles or child enemy spawns.

weapon_interaction.collision: One damageable swarm core; shots, melee and explosions each hit it at most once per attack under weapon rules.
weapon_interaction.projectiles: Respect existing projectile collision/despawn, aim and range; no per-fly pierce multiplier.
weapon_interaction.knockback: Use existing weapon impulse, clamp displacement to flight bounds/solids, then resume random flight without aggro.
weapon_interaction.health_visuals: Standard health fractions apply but multiple thresholds may be skipped by low HP/high damage. Initial mockup only includes movement and death; six damage stages are not claimed delivered.

limitations: Live visual readability and fairness pending
No six damage-stage artwork; hit flash and optional continuous health bar only
No playable boss integration; bosses are excluded from contact until exposed-collider support exists
Only the two currently playable ranged weapons exercised; future melee/explosions remain unimplemented

hunting_mode.status: Prototype148 packaged endpoint/contact checks and bounded grounded still review passed; continuous boundary motion and all corners/forms remain unverified
hunting_mode.damage_rule: Every living phase damages hero on contact, including moving tells and outer rendered weapon flies. Shared24HP and contact damage amount/cooldown retained;48px core plus per-fly rendered rectangles.
hunting_mode.targeting: Capture hero center when proximity starts the moving tell; charge straight toward that location, without tracking a dodge.
hunting_mode.cycle: Continuous random wander, random weapon per acquisition, moving morph/tell, double-speed charge, moving cloud reform on arrival, repeat.
hunting_mode.obstacles: 4px center terrain sweep reaches grounded hero center; individual fly glyphs project against solid surfaces. Trial acquisition expands beyond original wander pocket. Physical blocking walls still end a charge.
